items.title: BofA downgrades 3 European chip stocks on high memory exposure
items.summary: Investing.com - Bank of America has downgraded three European semiconductor stocks in a single sweep, cutting VAT Group to Neutral from Buy, Comet to Underperform from Buy, and Inficon to Underperform from Neutral, warning that high memory exposure leaves all three vulnerable if the chip cycle turns.
